project_name: AEROFLOW AI - Smart Airport Operations & Passenger Experience Platform
design_vision: A high-precision, cinematic aviation interface combining Swiss tactical command center telemetry for operations staff with a fluid, physics-infused journey chronicle for passengers. Zero lag, high visual tension, deep contrast, and bespoke airplane vector timeline mechanics.

typography.font_family_heading: Cabinet Grotesk, Outfit, Clash Display, sans-serif
typography.font_family_body: IBM Plex Sans, Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif
typography.font_family_mono: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tight leading-tight

layout_architecture.portal_structure: Dual Mode Architecture with Instant Switching in Top Nav (Passenger Flow <-> Staff Ops Console)

views.name: Passenger Journey Experience
views.description: Consumer delight portal with live flight lookup, aircraft vector timeline, stage wait forecasting, departure countdown, carousel ETA for arrival, and notification subscriptions.
key_sections: Flight Tracker Search Bar (Flight #, Route, Date with instant autocomplete & mock pre-fills: AI 102, 6E 2341, UK 819, BA 142)
Flight Hero Dossier (Aircraft type, Gate, Departure/Arrival times, Status badge, Weather, Terminal map pin)
The 'AeroPath' Aircraft Journey Timeline (Vector plane gliding across 5 milestones with predicted wait times & crowd density badges)
Smart Time Recommendation Card ('Leave Home By' & 'Target Airport Entry' dynamic calculations based on live traffic & security queue)
Arrival Luggage Tracker (Flight bag status, Assigned Carousel #, First Bag ETA, Last Bag Completion forecast)
Pre-Flight Notification Opt-in Modal (SMS/WhatsApp/Push toggle with alert stage preferences)

views.name: Ops Commander & Operations Hub
views.description: Tactical command dashboard for airport management, ground handlers, and CISF security officers.
key_sections: Live Terminal Congestion Map (Interactive visual heatmap of Check-in Halls, CISF Security Bays, Immigration, and Gate Concourses)
Zone Telemetry & Staff Counter Allocator (Current passenger count vs throughput threshold, AI recommended active counters slider/action)
Baggage Carousel Allocation Matrix (Flight -> Carousel assigning table, live luggage conveyor state, unload progress, First/Last bag timer)
Live Anomaly & Ops Alert Center (Severity filters: Critical/High/Medium, quick acknowledge, re-route passenger load, resolve action)
Historical Analytics & ML Forecast Studio (Hourly passenger volume line chart, 7-day 24h heatmap, carousel turn efficiency, alert frequency)
Carousel Master List Manager & CSV Simulator (CRUD modal to add/edit carousels, status toggle, maintenance lock, batch mock upload)

airplane_journey_timeline_specification.concept: A sleek, responsive horizontal (desktop) and dynamic stepped vertical (mobile) timeline featuring an animated SVG aircraft with an energy particle trail, glowing progress beacons, and hoverable milestone nodes.

milestones.name: Terminal Gate Entry
milestones.ai_prediction: DigiYatra Gates 2-4 clear (1 min). Manual queue at Gate 1 (6 min).

milestones.name: Check-in & Bag Drop
milestones.ai_prediction: Counter 18 Self-Bag-Drop optimal. Queue clearing fast.

milestones.name: Security Check (CISF)
milestones.ai_prediction: Peak rush hour. Lanes 5-8 recommended. Trays automated.

milestones.name: Boarding Gate
milestones.ai_prediction: Boarding begins at 18:40. Priority Group 1 first.

interactive_features: Active milestone scrubber: Clicking any milestone activates detail popup with queue camera snippet, counter suggestions, and step directions.
Flight Mode Toggle: Departure Journey vs Arrival (Baggage Claim) Mode.
Domestic vs International Toggle (Dynamically inserts/removes Immigration stage & adjusts target airport arrival buffer from 2h to 3h).

motion_and_physics.engine: framer-motion + CSS accelerated transforms (strictly no heavy WebGL to guarantee 60fps on mobile)

mouse_interaction.radar_spotlight: Subtle cursor tracking radial-gradient highlight over dark cards (`pointer-events-none` layer)
mouse_interaction.card_tilt: Lightweight 3D hover perspective (rotateX/rotateY clamp at max 5deg) on key summary widgets

cinematic_loading.style: Aviation HUD Radar Boot Sequence with telemetry scan lines, coordinate calibrations, and audio-visual radar sweep animation

transitions.page_switch: framer-motion AnimatePresence with opacity + 15px Y-axis translate (0.25s ease-out)
transitions.tab_filter: layoutId animated pill highlight on selected tab/pill

image_urls.description: Cinematic runway night takeoff with landing lights for the passenger journey portal backdrop
Futuristic white architectural terminal concourse with skylights for terminal guide modal and zone map
High contrast airport departure flight information board for operations telemetry aesthetics
Aviation avionics digital display for analytics header backdrop & Ops alert monitoring

components_blueprint.description: Sticky glassmorphism header with AeroFlow logo, live UTC/IST airport clock, flight search trigger, Passenger/Ops toggle with role indicator, sound effect toggle, and Theme switcher.
Search bar with flight number autocomplete, route selector (DEL -> BOM, BLR -> DXB, etc.), recent queries, and quick-load demo flights.
The marquee Airplane vector timeline showcasing real-time stage navigation, wait predictions, congestion heat rings, and dynamic arrival buffer calculation.
Calculates 'Leave Home by' using distance + live airport queue metrics, showing traffic buffer, terminal transit time, and flight boarding gate closure alert.
Arrival mode luggage tracker with live carousel assignment, belt conveyor animation, First Bag ETA clock, and completion progress.
Accessible modal with channels (WhatsApp, SMS, Push Notification) and fine-grained toggles for Gate Change, Security Surge, and Boarding Call.
Interactive terminal zone schematic (Check-in, Security T1/T2/T3, Immigration North/South, Gates 1-50) with color-coded density and click-to-rebalance controls.
Comprehensive carousel management matrix with drag/select re-assignment, throughput meters, bag unload status, and baggage delay flag indicators.
Live operations alerts queue (Congestion, Understaffing, Baggage Delay, Anomaly) with priority filters, audio ping, acknowledge badge, and resolve actions.
Recharts-powered visual telemetry featuring 24h passenger volume trends, hour-by-day congestion heatmap matrix, carousel utilization bars, and alert resolution velocity.
Master carousel list CRUD modal allowing addition of new belts, flight assignment editing, maintenance status locks, and mock JSON/CSV data load.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_convention: All clickable buttons, inputs, modals, tabs, status pills, and chart containers must have unambiguous kebab-case `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid="flight-search-input"`, `data-testid="journey-step-security"`, `data-testid="nav-mode-ops-toggle"`, `data-testid="alert-acknowledge-btn-1"`).
accessibility_and_testing.apca_contrast: Text over tinted backgrounds must maintain high APCA contrast. Dark backgrounds must use #F8FAFC text for primary labels and #94A3B8 for secondary.
accessibility_and_testing.aria_roles: All custom interactive components must have appropriate ARIA attributes (role='tablist', role='dialog', aria-expanded, aria-live for telemetry feeds).

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts or unstyled default components.
Do not use transparent background on dropdowns, modals, navbars or popovers. Always use glassmorphism with solid backing: `bg-[#0E131F]/90 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10`.
Ensure all interactive elements have hover, focus-visible, and active micro-interactions.
Implement Sonner toast notifications for actions such as 'Alert Acknowledged', 'Counter Staffing Adjusted', 'Notification Subscribed', 'Carousel Reassigned'.
Support both desktop multi-column dense layouts and mobile single-column stacked touch layouts seamlessly.
Include pre-seeded realistic Indian and International flight mock data (e.g., Air India AI 102 to JFK, IndiGo 6E 2341 to BOM, Vistara UK 819 to BLR, Emirates EK 512 to DXB).
Keep motion performant: use CSS GPU-accelerated transforms and framer-motion stagger containers. Avoid heavy 3D WebGL render loops that cause mobile lag.
Use data-testid on every interactive button, input, toggle, tab, and card.
